crossRefs.note: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
David was greatly distressed; for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved…
He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”
Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of…
For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

translations.web: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
translations.bsb: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
translations.kjv: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
translations.asv: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.
